summary.name: Cocoa Rest Client
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native Apple OS X app for testing and debugging HTTP/REST endpoints with a lightweight, curl-like UI.
use_cases: testing REST API endpoints during development
sending PUT and POST bodies saved for reuse
comparing API responses with a diff
uploading files via multipart HTTP requests
summary.what_it_does:
Sends GET, PUT, POST, DELETE and HEAD requests and lets you set request headers and view response headers. It automatically pretty prints XML and JSON responses. A drawer lets you save and reuse request URLs, bodies and headers. It supports SSL including untrusted certificates, optional redirect following, HTTP Basic or Digest auth, raw or parameter-list bodies, multipart and form-encoded uploads, and a unified diff tool for comparing responses.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Native Cocoa app described as lightweight with low memory usage
Automatic pretty printing of XML and JSON
Released under the New BSD License
Built with json-framework and Sparkle for auto-updates
caveats: Latest version is only distributed on GitHub, not the Mac App Store
Version 1.3.4 was the last to support OS X 10.6
